messages:
Maya (infra): Heads-up — kicking off a 'snowball' demand-scenario sweep for the upcoming Dec promo stacked with holiday traffic. Objective: validate preemptible hedge, network fallthrough behavior, and per-cluster runway. I want region/cluster projections + suggested reserve deltas by EOD.

OpsBot: nightly-metering-report attached — baseline daily burn: ~48,000 GPU-hrs. Current reserved capacity: 38,000 GPU-hrs. Spot/pool estimate: ~15,000 GPU-hrs available (high churn window).

Sanjay: can you split that by region+cluster? also call out egress/network caps — last time eu-west hit the 1.25Gbps tail and we had retries. :eyes:

Maya (infra): sure. rough peak-day projection codeblock below (quick, conservative numbers):

```
Projection (peak day):
- us-west-2 / cluster-alpha: demand 9,500 GPU-hrs -> reserved 7,000, spot 3,000 (spot churn HIGH)
- eu-west-1 / cluster-bravo: demand 6,000 GPU-hrs -> reserved 5,000, spot 2,000 (observed egress cap ~1.2Gbps)
- ap-southeast-1 / cluster-charlie: demand 4,000 GPU-hrs -> reserved 2,500, spot 1,500 (2 AZ fragility)
- us-east-1 / cluster-delta: demand 7,800 GPU-hrs -> reserved 6,500, spot 1,500
Safe reserve delta (global buffer): +1,200 GPU-hrs
If spot pools drop by 50% on peak -> expected throughput impact: ~18-25% latency increase for gen-prod routes, and 12-20% drop in throughput for rerank workloads.
```

Liam: thanks. two quick asks: 1) can we enable soft cross-region fallback from ap-southeast -> us-west for user-facing low-latency routes? fallback must preserve KV cache affinity where possible. 2) if spot failures happen, suggest reducing microbatch size from 8->4 to reduce tail latency spike.

Caroline: cost tradeoff note — reserving extra 1,200 GPU-hrs permanent monthly increases bill by roughly ~$55k/month (ballpark). Alternative: keep current reserved and expand preemptible pool + implement aggressive autoscale for short bursts (saves ~30% unit cost but increases failure exposure). Need finance signoff if we go +reserve.

Maya (infra): action items for this sweep: 
1) +500 GPU-hrs reserved in eu-west (temporary canary)
2) add soft-fallback routing policy: ap-southeast -> us-west (region-preference with KV affinity tag)
3) run a prefix-cache warmup job across cluster-charlie and cluster-alpha before promo starts
4) stress test: simulate 25% spot-loss and measure latency/throughput delta (Liam to own microbatch tuning)

OpsBot: deploybot: applied canary reserved delta to eu-west cluster-bravo (500 GPU-hrs) at 2026-01-18T03:12:10Z. Autoscale policy version bumped to v2.3-canary.

Sanjay: acked. I'll run the egress simulation to confirm whether we need a network egress throttle/queue in front of eu-west. If egress hits, we should degrade heavy rerank to smaller model first.

Liam: I'll kick off microbatch stress runs in the next hour and post traces. Expect initial results ~ +45m.

Caroline: filing a quick finance estimate ticket for the +reserve option and a comparative scenario for preemptible-heavy approach. Will ping legal if we need shorter-term commit changes.

Maya (infra): perfect. small note: label all canary resources with `promo-dec-snowball-2026` so reporting picks them up. We'll reconvene next Wed 11:00 PT to readout sweep numbers and decide final runway. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
